title: 第19章 敕封鬼差惩恶扬善第20章 鬼差拘魂阴间公堂
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
“详细说来。”
李越淡淡道。
虽然他的声音很平淡，但听在廖秀儿、廖承平两名鬼物耳中，却满是威严。
“尊神老爷，我和兄长父母早逝，相依为命长大。”
“但因我生得貌美，那富户廖大强的长子廖熊，便想要纳我为妾。”
“我不从。”
“有一日晚间我来这里打水恰巧碰上廖熊，他就想要对我用强。”
“我誓死不从，他恼羞成怒将我推下了井里！”
“我哥哥来寻我，也被躲藏在一旁的廖熊推下井中！”
“我兄妹都死在井里，这口井也就被村长封了起来，而那廖熊——”
说到这里，廖秀儿眼中满是恨意：
“他不知从哪里得来一张符箓，让我兄妹哪怕化作了鬼魂，也近他不得！”
“而如今他更是去了镇上，在镇上开了一家酒楼，生活不知有多惬意！”
“小女子只恨，自己化作了鬼魂都不能报仇！”
“请尊神为我们兄妹做主！”
她深深的磕头，一个又一个。
廖承平在一旁沉默不语，只是跟着不断磕头。
李越伸出右手。
顿时‘土地册’浮现在他手上。
随着他的目光落下，‘土地册’自动翻到廖熊那一页。

上面记录了廖熊的生平事迹，其中有一项与廖秀儿所说一般无二。
身为四海村土地正神。
他不仅要赏善，也要罚恶。
举头三尺有神明。
这并不是一句空话！
身为他「辖区」内的村民，从出生开始的一切生平事迹，都事无巨细的记录在了‘土地册’上。
做了什么善事、恶事，一件都不会落下。
“你们之事，本神自会替你们做主。”
“本神麾下还缺阴兵、鬼差，你们兄妹二人，可愿入本神门下成为阴兵、鬼差？”
他俯视着廖秀儿、廖承平两人，询问道。
「神只征战」中的第二部分，就是属神之战。
而阴兵也属于属神之战的力量。
更何况——
很多事情还是需要麾下阴兵、鬼差去办的。
总不能拘魂之类的小事，也让他堂堂土地正神去做吧？
“尊神愿意替我们兄妹做主，我们兄妹任凭尊神吩咐！”
廖秀儿果断道。
廖承平立即跟着点头。
“很好。”
李越脸上带着满意之色。
content_en:
"Tell me the details."
Li Yue said calmly.
Although his voice was very plain, in the ears of the two ghosts Liao Xiuer and Liao Chengping, it was full of majesty.
"Master God, my brother and I grew up dependent on each other since our parents died young."
"But because I was born beautiful, Liao Xiong, the eldest son of the wealthy family Liao Daqiang, wanted to take me as his concubine."
"I won't obey."
"One night I came here to fetch water and happened to meet Liao Xiong, and he wanted to use force on me."
"I refused to obey, but he got angry and pushed me down the well!"
"My brother came to look for me, but he was pushed into the well by Liao Xiong who was hiding aside!"
"Both my brother and sister died in the well, and the well was sealed by the village chief. And Liao Xiong——"
Speaking of this, Liao Xiuer's eyes were full of hatred:
"He got a talisman from nowhere, so that even if my brother and sister turn into ghosts, they can't get close to him!"
"And now he has gone to the town and opened a restaurant in the town. I don't know how comfortable his life is!"
"The little girl only hates that she can't take revenge even if she turns into a ghost!"
"Please honor God and make the decision for us brothers and sisters!"
She kowtowed deeply, one after another.
Liao Chengping remained silent and kowtowed.
Li Yue stretched out his right hand.
Suddenly the 'Land Book' appeared in his hand.
As his eyes fell, the 'Land Book' automatically turned to the page of Liao Xiong.
It records Liao Xiong's life story, one of which is exactly the same as what Liao Xiuer said.
As the land god of Sihai Village.
He not only wants to reward good, but also punish evil.
There is a god three feet above your head.
This is not an empty talk!
As a villager in his "area", all life events from his birth are recorded in the "land book" in detail.
No matter what good or evil deeds you do, none of them will be left behind.
"This god will make the decision for you."
"I still lack Yin soldiers and ghost soldiers under my command. You two, brother and sister, are you willing to join this god's sect and become Yin soldiers and ghost soldiers?"
He looked down at Liao Xiuer and Liao Chengping and asked.
The second part of "God Only Conquers" is the battle of God.
The Yin soldiers also belong to the power of divine warfare.
What's more -
Many things still need to be done by the underworld soldiers and ghost missions under his command.
You can't just let him do small things like soul arresting, right?
"The Lord is willing to make decisions for us brothers and sisters, and we brothers and sisters are at our mercy!"
Liao Xiuer said decisively.
Liao Chengping nodded immediately.
"Very good."
Li Yue had a look of satisfaction on his face.
